mentions.name: FUSE-based bidirectional file sync tool
mentions.description: A tool that lets two devices browse files synchronously and bidirectionally sync edits between them via FUSE mounts, implemented by tunneling TCP between the devices.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got a similar tool but went the other way around, I wanted to browse files synchronously (and bidirectional sync of edits) between two devices via FUSE mounts, and ended up tunneling TCP for this in the end.

evidence.value: I got a similar tool but went the other way around, I wanted to browse files synchronously (and bidirectional sync of edits) between two devices via FUSE mounts, and ended up tunneling TCP for this in the end.
